items.title: Mosaic (MOS) Stock Looks Undervalued Against the Sales It Generates
items.summary: Mosaic has seen its share price fall over several years, even though investors still look at it as a key fertilizer producer tied closely to global crop demand. With the stock now around US$18.79, the live issue is whether that market value can be sensibly explained by the company’s sales.
